title: Vertical editor how-to with whip pans and a device turn
summary: A 27 s vertical tutorial: a laptop shows a video editor, the camera dives into its canvas and whip-pans between screenshot, inspector and timeline while a phone frame turns in 3D; two hard-cut extras, then mark and typed URL.
use_when: A creative or editing tool explains its whole workflow in under 30 s with voice-over
Vertical social feed (reels, shorts) where each VO step needs a matching UI moment
The product turns a flat screenshot into a framed, animated device shot
A how-to that should end on the mark and a typed URL

look.type_style: UI sans in the editor chrome (small, ~1.5 % H); end URL in medium-weight rounded grotesk, lowercase, ~2.5 % H, centred on black

sfx.event: whip-pan between canvas, inspector and timeline (rows 2, 3, 6)
cursor flips a toggle / picks the device frame (row 3)
device turns to its side and back (row 5)
URL types on letter by letter (row 11)

structure.shot: laptop on a dark desk, magenta light streaks above; the editor opens with a blue glow rim on its sidebar panel
structure.camera: pull-out ~1.25→1.00 over the first 30 fr (motion.json -25 %/s in s 0), then near-static drift
structure.motion: screen fades up from black in ~8 fr (±0.25 s); glow rim brightens 0.50→1.50 s, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: camera is inside the editor canvas: a flat phone-app screenshot on a blue gradient canvas, toolbar and timeline below
structure.camera: push-in 1.00→1.15 from 3.27 to 3.77 (screenshot width measured on cells), then whip-pan right at 4.00
structure.motion: screenshot sits flat; whip 4.00→4.27 with motion-blur, easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: inspector panel at full height: depth, tilt, size, opacity rows; cursor toggles background and opens the frame menu with a device option
structure.camera: static on the panel 4.50 to 6.00 (motion.json hold in s 5), whip-pan back left at 6.00
structure.motion: cursor-path to toggle at 4.77, to frame row at 5.77; menu drops at 6.00, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); whip ~8 fr easings.inExpo (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the screenshot now wears a dark phone frame, selected with blue handles, centred on the blue canvas
structure.camera: settles from the whip 6.27→6.77, then static; a slight yaw starts at 7.77
structure.motion: frame lands with the whip, springs.ui ~12 fr (±0.25 s); selection handles visible throughout

structure.shot: the framed phone turns in 3D: side view, back with camera bump, side again, then returns to the front, slightly tilted
structure.camera: orbit: device yaw ~70° at 8.00, back ~150° at 8.50, side 9.00, front with ~10° tilt at 9.27 to 9.77
structure.motion: turn read at 0.25 s steps only, suggested springs.heavy ~30 fr per half turn; selection handles follow the device

structure.shot: camera-move keyframing: canvas pans, phone slides to the right edge, purple keyframe bars appear on the timeline, an empty canvas with a corner of the device
structure.camera: whip-pan right at 10.00 (motion.json -103 px/s), cut-like slides at 10.77 and 13.00, whip 14.27; dolly between
structure.motion: purple keyframe tracks grow on the timeline 11.27→12.00 easings.outExpo (±0.25 s); device edges in from the right at 13.50

structure.shot: playback of the result: the phone rises from lying flat to upright, turns from back to front and holds in its frame
structure.motion: phone rotates up ~90° 14.50→14.77, yaw back→front 14.77→15.27, settle suggested springs.heavy ~24 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: dark tilted plane of task chips, numbers and avatars in deep depth of field; a status pill with a progress label appears mid-shot
structure.camera: tilt-plane pan right at ~125 px/s @1920 (motion.json s 16 to 19, coherence 0.86 to 1.00), constant
structure.motion: pill fades in at 18.27 (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint; rest drifts with the plane, easings.linear

structure.shot: light editor: preview window over coral audio waveform clips; a short two-word caption types into the preview, then a longer caption
structure.camera: push-in 20.00→20.27 from white, pan right 21.50→22.00 (motion.json +710 px/s in s 21), pull-out at 22.00 to reveal the clip list
structure.motion: caption appears letter by letter (typewriter, ~2 letters per 0.25 s); white fade-out 22.77→23.07

structure.shot: white brand mark centred on black, assembling from two pieces
structure.motion: pieces sweep into place 23.10→23.77 (~20 fr, ±0.25 s), suggested springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable); holds 37 fr

structure.shot: the mark is replaced by the URL in white, centred, typed on; holds on black in audio silence (25.51 to end)
structure.motion: typewriter ~3 letters per 0.25 s, URL complete at 25.77 (23 fr); hold 53 fr to end

params.brand: brand.json: bg, fg, accent (canvas blue), mark, display font for the URL
params.content.screenshot: one phone-app screenshot that gets framed and turned
params.content.vo: 9 short VO lines, ~70 words, ~2.9 words/s: promise, five steps (drop, frame, effect, camera, export), a two-line 'done' beat, creative extras, CTA
params.content.extras: two extra-feature shots after the main flow (tilted dark UI plane, light audio editor)
params.content.url: URL typed on the end card
params.timing.bpm: music tempo, default 114.8; cut the two extras on beats

notes: One continuous shot 0 to 16.30 (no cuts in cuts.json; near misses at 2.70 and 11.20 are camera moves), then 3 hard cuts. Rows inside shot 1 split at visible state changes, all continuous. All times from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); rotation angles and spring names are suggestions. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (the reference has music and VO; SFX may exist but cannot be separated). Energy = build by the cut-rate rule (0 cuts in the first third, 2 in the last). Proposed term: mark-assemble (row 10). VO ends 24.19; last 2.0 s is silent.
